Synopsis:
The party has been celebrating how they saved the tiefling refugees from the goblins. Everyone's in high spirits. The player and Shadowheart reflect a little on events and may find themselves open to flirtation. If their relationship with each other (and the absence of any other partners) allows for it, they may agree to another liaison later in the night - a bonding/romantic one.

Cluster Contexts:

Off‑screen context: both the player and Shadowheart are Nautiloid crash survivors who were tadpoled by mind flayers; Shadowheart is exhausted, guarded, and secretly devoted to Shar, with a mission she won’t discuss. In this scene she’s relaxed enough to flirt and offers a liberated bottle of wine, but insists on waiting for privacy. Whether that offer becomes a later romantic/bonding liaison depends on the player’s relationship with Shadowheart and the absence of other partners.

Curiously, they realise that they both feel fine - contrary to what is thought to occur.

In this scene she’s relaxed enough to flirt and offers a liberated bottle of wine, but insists on waiting for privacy. Whether that offer becomes a later romantic/bonding liaison depends on the player’s relationship with Shadowheart and the absence of other partners.

After the party, this companion is still trying to come down from all the energy, and with a good enough bond it is possible for the player avatar to flirt and unlock a romance option.This specific dialog occurs after tieflings have been massacred.

After the goblin victory slaughtering the tieflings, Shadowheart is very inebriated in camp. She feels guilty about the massacre, but can't comprehend why. As a result, she's belligerent and moody with the player unless actively calmed down.

The party stops to camp for the night - the second instance of this happening. Shadowheart seeks to confide in the player about what's been happening to them, in particular the tadpole parasite lodged in their heads and the transformation that is supposed to follow. Curiously, they realise that they both feel fine - contrary to what is thought to occur.
After the goblin hunt celebration party, this companion has made arrangements to get intimate with the player at night.
context: The party is camped and celebrating that they rescued the tiefling refugees from the goblins, so everyone’s in high spirits and many companions are still about — any intimate moment will need to wait until others have turned in. Off‑screen, both the player and Shadowheart are Nautiloid crash survivors who were tadpoled by mind flayers; Shadowheart is often exhausted and guarded, secretly devoted to Shar, and carrying a mission she won’t discuss. In this scene she’s unusually relaxed and flirtatious, offering a liberated bottle of wine but insisting it be enjoyed someplace private and that they wait until the camp is quiet. Whether that offer turns into a later romantic/bonding liaison depends on the player’s relationship with Shadowheart and the absence of other partners; the example lines show the player agreeing to meet after everyone has drifted off.
